jobs.title: GTM Product Manager - Marketing Operations
jobs.jd_full:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

  • Own the technical implementation of our Marketing Operations Foundations program - our strategic marketing processes and products that enable how Remote acquires, nurtures, serves, and grows customers. Work with Marketing Ops, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Data, and Legal to translate strategic requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Be a part of a marketing operations data transformation
  • Define product strategy, architecture, and roadmaps while treating business systems as products rather than standalone tools.
  • Drive technology decisions, including build vs. buy evaluations, AI adoption, and long-term platform evolution.
  • Build and ship GTM products and features using AI tools
  • Partner with stakeholders across Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Business Systems, Data, AI, and Engineering to deliver scalable business capabilities.
  • Shape the future of Remote's Revenue Technology ecosystem by continuously improving the products that power our go-to-market organization.

What you bring

  • Experience owning the technical implementation of business systems, technology products, or product portfolios within a Marketing Operations environment—ideally with hands-on experience addressing data governance, compliance frameworks, or system integration challenges at scale.
  • Strong understanding of marketing data architecture, integrations, data models, and end-to-end marketing processes, with the ability to identify and articulate interconnected dependencies across CRM, marketing automation, analytics, and data platforms.
  • Experience leading or managing complex, multi-month technical initiatives involving cross-functional teams, with proven ability to break down ambiguous problems into executable roadmaps.
  • Hands-on experience with data quality, data retention policies, consent management, or regulatory compliance (GDPR, CCPA) in a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Ability to evaluate build vs. buy decisions and determine when capabilities should be delivered through configuration, automation, AI, custom development, or third-party technology—with experience executing these decisions in complex, multi-system environments.
  • Excitement for and experience in using AI tools such as Claude Code to build tooling, automation, and processes.
  • Excellent technical communication and stakeholder management skills—ability to translate technical complexity into clear narratives for non-technical stakeholders, and align teams around a shared vision.
  • Experience working with technologies commonly used across GTM, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, LeanData, Outreach, ZoomInfo, Clay, Qualified, APIs, integration platforms, and business intelligence tools.
  • Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities.
  • Writes and speaks fluent English.
  • It's not required to have experience working remotely, but considered a plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, roadmap, architecture, and lifecycle for one or more Marketing products/processes and the business capabilities they enable.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on business value, customer needs, and strategic objectives while defining measurable product success metrics.
  • Own the long-term evolution of your product ecosystem, ensuring systems remain scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business strategy.
  • Evaluate and recommend build, buy and configure AI-driven solutions to deliver new capabilities while simplifying and consolidating the technology landscape.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into scalable solutions, balancing stakeholder requests with long-term product direction.
  • Own governance, documentation, release planning, adoption, and ongoing product performance.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Marketing Operations Principal
  • Team: Revenue Operations – GTM Systems
  • Team size: TBD
  • Location: For this position we welcome everyone to apply, but we will prioritize applications from locations within EMEA and EAST AMER as we encourage our teams to diversify.
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Application process

Roughly 4 hours across 2–3 weeks

  1. Interview with Recruiter
  2. Interview with Hiring Manager
  3. Product Challenge & Presentation
  4. Interview with VP Revenue Operations
  5. Bar Raiser Interview

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is

$132,000—$147,000 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:

  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • budget towards co-working spaces, learning and wellness (including gym memberships)
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • home office budget & IT equipment

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see here.

Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Growth
jobs.jd_full:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About the role

You’ll be the product owner for how companies discover Tremendous, sign up, and send their first reward.

Most companies research us before they ever meet a salesperson. They find us through a search, an ad, or a reward somebody sent them. A fair number sign up on their own, either because they're too small for a sales rep or because they just prefer it. You'll own product growth overall, but self-serve clients are your primary focus and scorecard. At the top of the funnel we can't tell who's a solo marketer and who's a future enterprise buyer, so you’ll build for both.

The Growth team doesn't exist yet, so you'll arrive, borrow engineers from another squad to get moving, and write the roadmap we hire against. You'll have real influence over what this team becomes and who's on it.

One thing to know up front: the standard product-led growth playbook doesn't apply here. We have no free tier, no trial, and no paywall, so the usual levers don't exist. We also don't have the traffic for most A/B tests to reach significance. You'll need to look at a flow and know what's wrong with it rather than wait for a test to tell you.

The product management team today is 7 PMs, led by a co-founder who serves as Head of Product. You'll also work with Marketing on campaigns and with RevOps on the handoffs between self-serve and sales.

What you’ll do

  • Own first touch to first reward sent. Signup, onboarding, and the first order are yours outright. On the site and landing pages, you own conversion and experiments; Marketing owns brand, content, and spend.

  • Develop the growth roadmap, then help staff the squad that runs it (both through internal transfers and outside hires).

  • Build the systems that let us test. Standing up a landing page, changing it, and killing it should take a day, without waiting on an engineering sprint.

  • Run campaigns with Marketing. We'll pull a growth marketer into your team's cadence so a campaign ships end to end: audience, copy, landing page, emails, ads.

  • Give promising acquisition channels product and engineering muscle: referrals, programmatic SEO, AI-search and chatbot referrals, interactive tools, reward recipients becoming senders.

  • Turn incentives into a system. Today we hand out test funds and fee waivers case by case. You decide what we offer, to whom, and what it's worth.

  • Prototype with AI in hours, and put it in front of real companies the same week.

  • Work async. Most product work here happens in writing. If you're used to running product through meetings, this will feel different.

  • Report to Prateek Mehta (Group PM).

What you’ll bring

  • 6+ years shipping web products as a growth PM, founder, or engineer, with real time on acquisition, conversion, or activation. A founder or founding-engineer past is a strong plus.

  • Enough technical depth to ship without a full team. You can instrument a funnel, read the data, and build a landing page when that's the fastest path.

  • Taste in conversion flows. You can look at a signup page and say what's wrong with it, without a test telling you.

  • Judgment about when to test. You can tell whether traffic will resolve a question, and you're comfortable deciding from other evidence when it won't.

  • Healthy skepticism of growth playbooks. You know which parts assume a free tier, and which parts transfer.

  • Outstanding written communication. We're a documentation-first culture.

What's cool about the role

  • Blank slate. The team doesn't exist yet. You'll write the roadmap and we'll build the team around it. And since we're profitable, growth here is pure upside.

  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $240,000 to $315,000.

  • Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.

  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.

  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Special Projects
jobs.jd_full:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About the role

Most PMs at Tremendous run a squad. This role owns problems instead.

We're growing fast and spinning up new product areas. Each one needs research, a roadmap, and shovel-ready specs before we staff it. That's your job. You'll dig into areas where we might launch a squad, and run projects too small to need one.

You'll carry one or two projects at a time, drawn from the company's highest-priority open questions. When a problem proves worth solving, what happens next depends on how big the opportunity is.

If it justifies a long-term team, you'll likely build that squad and lead it as its PM. If it's worth building but smaller, you'll build it yourself with an engineer or two and design help from a related squad. If it's small and close to an existing squad's work, you'll hand it off with a finished brief, and that squad's PM will carry it forward. You'll have real influence over new project areas and which teams exist a year from now.

Today, the product management org is 7 PMs, led by a co-founder who serves as Head of Product.

You will

  • Report to our Co-founder / Head of Product, Kapil Kale

  • Own new product areas before they have a team. Develop a thesis, do the research, size the opportunity, and make a recommendation: spin up a squad, build it lean, hand it off, or kill it. Kill calls are as valuable as green lights.

  • Turn research into shovel-ready work. Your output is briefs, prototypes, and specs that a squad can pick up and build immediately.

  • Move quickly using AI. Use agents to dig through customer tickets, sales calls, usage data, and competitor research. Ship clickable prototypes in days to test ideas with real customers.

  • Run projects that don't need a full squad. Some work is worth doing but too small for a team. You'll drive these end-to-end with engineers from existing squads.

  • Cover a squad when needed. If a team is temporarily without a PM, you may step in. This is occasional, and your portfolio comes first.

  • Work async. Most product work here happens in writing. If you're used to running product through meetings, this will feel different.

You have

  • 6+ years building and shipping web applications as a designer, engineer, or product manager at tech companies, with at least 2 years taking new products from zero to one.

  • Comfortable being the only person accountable for an initiative that doesn't have a team yet.

  • Comfortable owning a portfolio instead of a single product. If validation kills your thesis, you move to the next bet without drama.

  • A track record of turning ambiguous opportunities into prioritized, shovel-ready roadmaps.

  • Strong product intuition, design judgment, and technical fluency. You hold your own with designers and engineers.

  • Outstanding written communication. We're documentation-first, and this role runs on briefs and decision memos that need to persuade senior stakeholders.

  • Founder, founding PM, or first-product-hire experience is a strong plus.

What’s cool about the role

  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $250,000 to $325,000.

  • Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.

  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.

  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

We’re looking for a Senior PM to join our Platform team. This team owns infrastructure, security, and internal tooling that keeps every other team shipping.

Today, the product management org is six PMs, led by a co-founder who serves as Head of Product.

You will

  • Report to our Co-founder / Head of Product, Kapil Kale.

  • PM the Platform team end-to-end. This team is responsible for security issues, AI infrastructure, security improvements, data / compliance, and technical upgrades, and you’ll be involved in all of it.

  • Work across technical systems. This is a highly technical product area that requires close collaboration with engineers and comfort discussing architecture, tradeoffs, implementation details, and complex technical problems.

  • Manage the team’s product roadmap. You’ll be working with stakeholders to help figure out what to build and when. When things are unclear, you'll resolve the ambiguity for the team.

  • Report back on what’s working. Once we ship, you’ll be responsible for helping the team understand the impact of their work.

You have

  • 4+ years of PM experience on a platform team (infrastructure, platform, security, search, data, etc).

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering or engineering management experience.

  • Exceptional technical fluency and problem-solving ability. You're comfortable discussing and solving complex technical problems with engineers.

  • Strong product intuition. You can look at a problem and see the right solution.

  • The ability to take a long-term strategy and a big feature backlog and translate that into roadmaps.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. We’re a documentation-first culture, and this role requires communicating effectively with senior stakeholders.

  • Genuine empathy for users and teammates. You want to understand their problems.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Our Product team builds and scales Toptal’s platform and products, working closely with our Operations and Engineering teams to support the organization’s growth. We embrace a data-focused approach to ensure each initiative on our product roadmap delivers a meaningful impact on our business and users. Our innovative technology platform enables us to deliver on-demand talent, without losing a human touch.

Are you a customer-centric Senior Product Manager with a proven track record of taking ownership and delivering results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? We’re looking for a self-starting Senior Product Manager to drive innovation at Toptal by building and scaling AI-driven products that expand the breadth and depth of our product and service offering.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will lead a team of engineers while working cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, and other Product Managers to define, build, and launch mission-critical initiatives built on Toptal’s AI platform. We need someone to drive end-to-end product discovery and delivery, using user research, data, and cross-functional collaboration to identify new opportunities and deliver impactful solutions. If you have a knack for building high-quality, extremely impactful products, we want you on our team!

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Own and lead all aspects of an established agile team, including backlog grooming, prioritization, and cross-functional coordination, with a focus on delivering AI-driven product capabilities.
  • Translate AI platform capabilities into customer-facing, talent-facing, and internal product experiences that deliver measurable business value.
  • Responsible for defining the scope of new product features and ongoing feature improvements.
  • Write and prioritize user stories and define acceptance criteria.
  • Establish and maintain a high level of credibility with internal and external partners.
  • Break down complex problems and use data, analytics, and user research to inform product direction and validate AI-driven solutions.
  • Track progress, assess risks, coordinate delivery, and actively communicate contingency and mitigation plans for the team.
  • Run various ad-hoc research and business analyses to assess opportunities and risks.
  • Take ownership of identifying and solving complex product challenges that align with both short-term goals and long-term strategic initiatives.
  • Apply system-analyst techniques and procedures, including consulting with users to determine hardware, software, or systems functional specifications.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal while independently starting to study and learn the Toptal product suite.
  • Become acquainted with your product area, the product goals, and those you will partner with.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Work cross-functionally and with other Product Managers to organize and prioritize your high-level roadmap and backlog.
  • Start collaborating closely with your development team.
  • Take over all in-flight and planned initiatives.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Fully support a product category, working collaboratively to complete quarterly planning and set OKRs.
  • Exercising discretion and independent judgment, launch features that deliver high business impact.
  • Be fully embedded into and own a development team.
  • Monitor and measure the success of your initiatives against company goals.
  • Continuously improve the team’s processes through meaningful contributions.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Work alongside other Product Managers to discover new product opportunities for your backlog.
  • Develop a repeatable model for delivering upon our roadmap initiatives.
  • Work across the Product team to measure and refine the roadmap, backlog, and processes to make improvements over time.
  • Constantly re-evaluate your roadmap’s alignment with the strategic goals of the business, adjusting where necessary.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Deliver your roadmap priorities and promises.
  • Ensure your team has an incredible record of building impactful products in a timely and elegant fashion.
  • Work cross-functionally to scale your team to meet the growing needs of our business and our users.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in a technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of proven software product management experience.
  • Proven ability to lead products end-to-end from early discovery and zero-to-one development through launch, iteration, and scale, even in ambiguous environments.
  • Proven experience managing the development and launch of mobile, desktop, and web applications across the full product lifecycle is a plus.
  • Knowledge of AI product development processes and best practices.
  • Experience designing and launching AI-powered product features that improved engagement, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience building and orchestrating intelligent workflows by connecting systems and automation tools to solve problems at scale.
  • Experience with third-party system integrations is a plus.
  • Comfortable working with SQL or spreadsheets to analyze data, as well as conducting research with internal and external users.
  • Strong expertise in using data to make decisions with a variety of tools and methodologies to gather and synthesize information.
  • Ability to creatively craft solutions through data and a customer-centric approach.
  • Ability to build wireframes and mockups, with an aptitude for keeping things simple.
  • Be meticulous and have a high bar for quality when writing user stories, reviewing designs, brainstorming technical approaches, and testing a feature before it is released.
  • Be humble, willing to learn, and do whatever is needed to help us accomplish our goals.
  • Experience using agile development methodologies with globally distributed teams and the ability to keep up with a fast-paced and global company.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You thrive in environments where you are empowered to lead by doing, working directly with users, data, and your team to make progress and drive results.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

jobs.title: Product Lead, AI Platform
jobs.jd_full:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

Product Lead, AI Platform

Are you a technical powerhouse who also loves building and mentoring high-performing teams? At 6sense, we are architecting the definitive intelligence layer for B2B—the reasoning engine that powers the world’s most sophisticated revenue organizations—and that transformation requires a foundational infrastructure where AI-driven reasoning powers every workflow. We are looking for a Product Lead to own our AI OS: the underlying operating system and orchestration engine that enables every product team at 6sense to build secure, reliable, and highly intelligent agentic experiences.

This is a Player/Coach role. You will be hands-on leading our core AI infrastructure while simultaneously serving as the people manager and program leader for a specialized pod of Product Managers. You aren't just managing a backlog; you are defining the architectural standards for how 6sense builds and ships AI at scale.

Why 6sense?

  • AI That Builds Pipe, Not Hype: Our Revenue AI™ identifies accounts ready to buy, crafts the right message, and qualifies meetings automatically. We don’t just surface data—we deliver intelligence and action.
  • Crack the Dark Funnel™: Less than 3% of buyers engage early. We uncover hidden buying signals, decode the “breadcrumb trails,” and help revenue teams connect with buyers in ways they never could before.
  • Orchestrate the Full Journey: From dynamic audience creation to multi-channel engagement, we empower marketers to reach the right accounts, at the right time, with the right message—across advertising, email, web, and sales.
  • Arm Operations Teams: Integrate insights, centralize audience creation, and maximize impact by connecting 6sense with your tech stack. We’re the single canvas for your entire GTM strategy.

Your Impact

As Product Lead, AI Platform, you will:

  • Lead and Scale a High-Performing Pod. Act as a formal people manager, responsible for hiring, coaching, and developing a specialized team of PMs. You will define the pod's operating model, ensuring clear boundaries between platform infrastructure and agentic capabilities.
  • Own the AI Orchestration Layer. Personally drive the design and evolution of our core orchestration engine, ensuring robust state management, tenant routing, and high-performance runtime for intelligent workflows.
  • Modernize the Developer Experience. Design and maintain the internal SDKs and capability registration patterns that allow other teams to build, register, and call intelligence tools within the AI OS.
  • Define Evaluation and Trust Standards. Build the frameworks, guardrails, and security protocols that ensure our AI outputs remain accurate, evidenced, and enterprise-grade across the entire platform.
  • Lead Foundational Model Strategy. Drive our model strategy, including routing logic, cost optimization, and compute infrastructure management to maximize both performance and efficiency.
  • Be a Strategic Partner to Leadership. Act as a force multiplier for the Head of Intelligence Product—surfacing technical risks early, driving clarity in platform architecture, and turning AI strategy into operating reality.

Strategic Themes You'll Drive

  • The Infrastructure of Reasoning. Shift the organization from hard-coded logic to a dynamic orchestration model, providing the "plumbing" that makes multi-step agentic tasks possible.
  • Contract-First Platform Development. Define the technical contracts that allow teams to consume AI capabilities in a self-serve, standardized manner.
  • Platform Efficiency & Scalability. Ensure the AI OS is built for enterprise scale, managing the balance between rapid innovation and the rigorous demands of global B2B environments.

What You'll Bring

  • People Leadership. Proven experience building and leading product teams. You know how to mentor senior PMs, manage performance, and create environments where technical builders thrive.
  • Technical Mastery. Deep, hands-on expertise with the modern AI stack. You’ve personally architected orchestration layers, developer platforms, or complex distributed systems at scale—not just sponsored the work.
  • Operating Rigor. You build operating rhythms that scale, drive clarity in ambiguous environments, and turn messy cross-team dependencies into clean execution.
  • Systems Thinking. You see the whole system—strategy, org, data, and execution—and know which lever to pull when something is stuck.
  • Experience. 8-10+ years in Product Management, with a focus on AI, Platform, or Infrastructure, including 3-5+ years of formal people management experience in a high-growth environment.

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Impact: You are architecting the Foundational AI Operating System of 6sense—the underlying infrastructure that every other agentic workflow across the company relies on to function.
  • Innovation: You get to define the technical standards for agent orchestration and model routing at enterprise scale, solving infrastructure challenges most companies haven't even encountered yet.
  • Growth: Join a rocket ship, learn every day, and accelerate your career in a collaborative, high-energy environment.
  • Fun: We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. Expect GIFs, puns, and the occasional ABM meme.

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager (Monetization Manager)
jobs.jd_full:
Job Description

WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON​

What you will focus on

  • Responsible for supporting the design and optimization of revenue strategies and helping adjust the balance between engaging player experiences and effective monetization models.
  • By proposing improvements to the product strategy based on player behavior and data analysis, A/B testing, and market research and through coordinated efforts with production and monetization teams (design, developer, marketing, live ops, data analysis, and economy design).

What it means on a daily basis​

Performances analysis

  • Identify the features, game modes, and player behaviors that need to be analyzed, and prioritize the areas with the highest impact.
  • Work with the DA team to conduct structured data analysis, from problem definition to recommendations.
  • Build and maintain shared performance dashboards and prepare monthly reports/product reviews to track KPIs and game performance against revenue and profitability targets.

Engagement Metrics and Monetization

  • Run A/B tests on events, offers, and shop configurations to improve engagement and monetization performance across player segments.
  • Document testing history, results, and key learnings; propose new features and improvements to increase monetization.
  • Review the GDD and support forecasting, post-launch performance tracking, and optimization recommendations, including initiatives to increase new and returning users.

Product Vision and Strategy

  • Use performance analysis to support the GM in defining the product vision, direction, and key focus areas for the coming year(s).
  • Help define the strategy and quarterly objectives needed to bring the vision to life, including the scope of each update.
  • Share product and monetization insights with the team to improve alignment, ownership, and commitment to the product’s evolution.

Recruitment Journey

Only candidates whose qualifications align with the role will be contacted. We sincerely appreciate your understanding.

  • (1) Screening call with HR (30 mins)
  • (2) Test
  • (3) Interview(s)
  • (4) Offer

Where this role can take you

This role offers versatile growth opportunities, allowing you to advance vertically into Senior Product Manager, Producer, Senior Producer.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED​

  • Experience in Product Management, Live Operation, Analytics, Monetization, or Consulting in product-oriented roles; gaming experience.
  • Good knowledge of top-grossing games and free-to-play (F2P) mechanics, with experience on at least 2 different titles, including one Live Game operated as a service.
  • Solid analytical and data modeling skills, with solid proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and basic knowledge of SQL, Python, or R.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in a related field; a Master’s degree and game design or game creation experience.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Detail-oriented, well-organized, and capable of performing effectively in a changing work setting.
  • Experienced at analyzing large datasets and turning them into actionable insights.
  • Someone who works well with others and has effective leadership and communication skills.
  • Motivated by video games and able to combine creative thinking with data-driven decision-making.

Additional Information

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

Benefits

  • A hybrid working model (5 working days per week – max 3 days WFH) ​
  • A range of well-being events and policies to support employees (leave scheme, medical check-up, wellness gift, wedding/condolences, etc.)
  • An attractive salary package with full salary for probation period​
  • Monthly lunch allowance and home office support​
  • Yearly salary review & bonuses​
  • Minimum 12 days of paid annual leave, plus 5 days of paid sick leave, Christmas leave, Birthday leave,… ​
  • 100% coverage of mandatory insurance and extra healthcare insurance. ​
  • Various training packages, including internal training, sponsorship training, and e-learning (iLearn, Udemy, O’Reilly, …). ​
  • Opportunities to collaborate and train with Gameloft worldwide experts and develop yourselves. ​
  • Relocation support for international candidates joining from overseas.
  • Other benefits from one of the best employers in Vietnam.

Life at Gameloft

  • A multicultural environment with 6+ nationalities, where hundreds of world-renowned game titles were born.​
  • An open-space office, a cafeteria, a ping-pong table, and a foosball table.
  • A gaming area equipped with multiple devices (PS, Nintendo Switch, …)
  • A wide range of internal events and sports clubs to boost connection and work-life balance.

Work Location: 3&4 Floor, Lilama 10 Building, 56 To Huu, Dai Mo Ward, Ha Noi, Vietnam.

How to proceed

Ready to get started? Click I’m interested/Apply and send us your updated CV and portfolio in English!

Please note:

To ensure a fair and compliant recruitment process under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), please submit your application through the official job posting, preferably via Gameloft website, Gameloft or Gameloft Vietnam LinkedIn pages, or SmartRecruiters. Applications sent via email or LinkedIn messages will not be considered.

Due to the high volume of applications, only candidates whose profiles most closely match the role needs will be contacted by our recruiters. We sincerely appreciate your understanding and interest.

jobs.title: Creative Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Kitsch

Kitsch is a certified female- and minority-owned global beauty brand. Our products are in 32,000+ retailers across 92 countries. We make essentials that make you feel exceptional.

The Role

We’re looking for a Creative Project Manager to join our Product Development team, reporting to the VP of Product & Assortment Strategy. This is a full-time contractor role, US-based and remote, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST.

You’ll be the link between Creative and Product Development. You’ll own the artwork and photography workflow from the first brief to the final file. And you’ll make sure our photo assets always match what’s really on the shelf.

What You’ll Do

  • Check every creative brief before work starts. Make sure it has images, copy, specs, and dieline details. Stop incomplete briefs before they slow down the team.
  • Own the priority queue for the Creative team. Balance requests from Product Development, Marketing, and other teams so no designer has to guess what’s next.
  • Track every packaging artwork project from start to finish. Always know its status. Push it forward yourself.
  • Be the source of truth for both teams. Share updates early. Clear up confusion before it becomes a delay.
  • Coordinate photography samples with the office manager, so samples are never missing or late for a shoot.
  • Keep Asana accurate and complete for every active project. Build timelines that match Product Development schedules.
  • Spot and fix workflow problems. Bring ideas that save the team time.
  • Watch for photo assets that no longer match the real product — a label change, a material swap, a formula update. Catch it first, and manage the fix from request to delivery.

What You Bring

  • A knack for turning a messy project into a clear one. You ask the right questions before work starts, not after.
  • Backbone. You push back on unrealistic timelines or incomplete briefs, and you find a workable path.
  • Comfort translating between two teams with different rhythms and priorities.
  • A proactive style. You chase the next step. You don’t wait to be asked.
  • Rigor with Asana as the single source of truth for your team.
  • A talent for building relationships across departments.
  • Comfort using AI tools day to day — drafting briefs, summarizing feedback, building templates.
  • A “whatever it takes” attitude. If a sample needs tracking down or a task needs updating, you do it.
  • Real pride in the work. A packaging error isn’t someone else’s problem — it’s yours to prevent.

jobs.jd_full:

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager I to join our expanding Product and Innovation team. Interactions with and presentations to engineering teams, engineering leaders, product leaders, executives, and third-party vendors will be common. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Job Description

Are you an experienced leader in contract management with strong NEC expertise? In this role you will manage complex contracts, guide stakeholders, and support delivery of nationally significant D&B infrastructure projects in Ireland including metro, aviation, rail, water and highway schemes comprising tunnelling and other heavy civil works. Join our Project & Programme Management team and help us deliver excellent outcomes.

Your new role

As NEC Project Manager, you will be responsible for contract and commercial management across major infrastructure programmes. You will set contract strategies, monitor contractor and consultant performance, manage claims and disputes, manage technical assurance and ensure consistent application of delivery standards. You will work as part of large, multi-disciplinary teams and provide clear direction to a range of stakeholders at all levels.

Your key responsibilities will be:

  • Lead NEC contract management and administration across major, complex infrastructure programmes
  • Develop and implement contract management strategies and performance frameworks
  • Monitor contractor/consultant performance and maintain KPIs
  • Lead claims and dispute management and support dispute‑avoidance activities
  • Manage contract interfaces across design, construction and operations teams
  • Provide contractual and commercial advice and produce performance reports
  • Lead and mentor a small team (typically 2–5 people)
  • Operate within a large, complex and multi-disciplinary organisational structure including managing interfaces with a range of stakeholders

About you

We’re looking for an assured leader with extensive contract and commercial experience, strong NEC knowledge and practical experience in managing contractor performance, claims and complex contract interfaces on major D&B infrastructure schemes. Typical background and skills include:

  • Extensive contract and project experience with significant NEC exposure on large design & build infrastructure schemes
  • Strong commercial and claims management capability, negotiation and analytical skills
  • Experience leading small teams and working with stakeholders at all levels
  • Familiarity with contract management systems (e.g. CEMAR) desirable
  • NEC3/4 ECC PM accreditation and a degree in a relevant discipline (e.g. Law, Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Construction, Project Management) preferred but equivalent experience will be considered
  • Chartered Project Professional (ChPP) or working towards this; and/or Associate Member / Member (or equivalent) of a recognised professional body (e.g. APM, IPM)

What we can offer you

  • Commitment to your development
  • Leaders guided by our Leadership Principles
  • A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are
  • Inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
  • The long‑term thinking of a foundation‑owned company
  • Flexible hybrid working model
  • 27 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Matched pension contributions
  • Private medical cover and life assurance

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application and CV online. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Application deadline: 31.10.2026

Interviews will be held throughout the recruitment process; the advert may close early if a suitable candidate is appointed.

​​Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll

​Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll employs more than 18,000 people globally across 35 countries. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, Management Consulting, and Architecture & Landscape. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the societies of tomorrow.

Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion

​Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds and characteristics. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at [email protected] with such requests.​​

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
The best CMMS for healthcare maintenance professionals.

Project Manager

About us:

At FSI, you’ll join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to empowering efficient and safe hospital operations. FSI supports over 400 million ft² of hospital space every year to run transformative, intelligent hospital maintenance operations. FSI is the most comprehensive computerized maintenance management software (CMMS) provider for healthcare, and we’re proud to serve over 1,000 hospitals with some of the largest networks in the country – including Atrium Health, UPMC, Yale New Haven, SSM Health, UNC Health, and many others. We work directly with our customers to build customized modern technology that fits their complex needs. In 2020, FSI received significant investments to grow and expand on the foundation established since the company began in 2002. We believe our most exciting chapter is just beginning, and we’re looking for talent that wants to make an impact. If you’re looking for a fast-paced, innovative community with a team focused on collaboration and empowerment through technology, we encourage you to get in touch.

Yourrole:

The Project Manager is responsible for leading client implementation projects from initiation through delivery. This role ensures that all aspects of the project are executed on time, within scope, and within budget, while maintaining high levels of client satisfaction. The ideal candidate will have strong organizational and communication skills, along with experience managing multiple projects simultaneously. Additional tasks will include software testing, implementation, maintenance, remote and onsite customer training and general support of the facilities management software applications. Candidates should be willing to expand their role in the company, learn additional technologies, and be open to all aspects of FSI’s service offerings.

Yourresponsibilities:

  • Managesmall to medium-sized customers through end-to-end successful implementations and launches, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and resource allocations.
  • Coordinate internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure seamless execution.
  • Project manage implementation tasks such as data migration, product training, and organizational roll-out strategies, coordinating internal resources as necessary.
  • Configure software
  • Maintain a minimum of 70% productivity.
  • Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during the implementation phase.
  • Conduct regular status meetings and provide clear, concise updates to stakeholders and team members in a timely manner.
  • Ensure all deliverables meet quality standards and client expectations.
  • Continuously improve implementation processes and methodologies.
  • Train customers in product and implementation configurations either onsite and/or virtual.

Whatyou’llbringto the team:

  • A passion for improving healthcare through technology
  • 3+ years of project management experience, ideally focused on SaaS or enterprise applications
  • Healthcare industry experience preferred
  • CMMS familiarity preferred
  • Knowledge of Regulatory Agency Standards (NFPA, Joint Commission) is a plus
  • Ability to work across various stakeholders including Users, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Product Management
  • Proven ability to keep multiple projects on track at the same time, with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to triage & prioritize support requests against multiple projects with a focus on customer satisfaction
  • 4-year degree or equivalent work experience
  • PMP or similar certification preferred
  • Strong understanding of project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Asana, Jira, Smartsheet)
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills

Work location:

Remote. Travel will be required.

Compensation:

The compensation offered for this position will be based upon relevant experience, qualifications, and work location. The starting salary is expected to fall within the range of $80,000-$90,000.

Our values:

  • Customer inspired.
  • Solutions-first.
  • One team.
  • Impactful experts.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Don’t meet all the requirements? We’re all on a journey to learn constantly and have areas to develop. If you bring some of the above skills to the table and are still developing in others – APPLY ANYWAY! Learning and experience isn’t a one-way path, if you believe you have the background needed to make an impact in this role, we’d love to hear from you.

We provide an environment of mutual respect where opportunities are available without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation, and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
